title: Hearty Nutty Vietnamese Yoghurt Bake
description: A dense and energizing Vietnamese dish featuring natural yoghurt, baked in a molcajete, with a nutty flavor profile, this recipe is perfect for a healthy breakfast or snack. It is macrobiotic-friendly and made with wholesome ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the yoghurt, oats, almonds, honey, desiccated coconut, sesame seeds, vanilla extract, and salt until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk the egg until it is lightly beaten.
Add the egg to the yoghurt mixture and stir until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a molcajete or a small baking dish.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the edges are set and the center is slightly jiggly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve warm, garnished with additional sesame seeds and chopped almonds if desired.
